question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

717, 738, 757, ?, 789
solution:
Logic : Decreasing odd number series is subtracted from each number subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85d9e6750ab1589984b75ebee4fd119be105478db49410c08b67e08e57043634.png] 

Hence, **"774**" is the correct answer.
